dedupe_keys.name: wind measurements with drone based wind lidars

description: Vasiljević, Nikola and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed proof of concept mounts two orthogonal telescopes on a hovering drone and connects them to a ground lidar through approximately one-hundred-metre fibres. The source compares the resulting wind measurements with a sonic reference at Riso and reports preliminary agreement. This establishes a physical measurement-system demonstration that supports wind-energy model inputs. It does not establish long-duration autonomous deployment, performance in all flight conditions or a complete released measurement dataset. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
